summary: Configured persistent inherited ACLs on node1. New designer-owned directories and files grant reviewer read/write access and deny visitor access. Existing content was preserved, no periodic repair job was added, and persistence was verified after reboot.
actions_performed: Created locked local accounts: designer, reviewer, and visitor.
Applied current and default POSIX ACLs throughout the project tree.
Verified reviewer read/write and visitor denial on nested designer-created content.
Confirmed the original brief.txt SHA-256 remained unchanged.
Restarted node1 safely and verified full recovery and ACL inheritance with a new post-reboot file.

evidence.requirement: Accounts and persistent inherited ACL configuration
evidence.summary: Shows successful configuration, all three locked local accounts, propagated default ACLs, designer ownership, and no periodic ACL repair job.

evidence.requirement: Reviewer read/write and visitor no access
evidence.summary: Reviewer successfully read and modified a designer-created document; visitor list, read, and write attempts were denied.
brief.txt retained SHA-256 5c077cd26fc7d84d4c43e9b5dfa674428ab1ce50c38422e63678d35043f43082 before configuration, after configuration, and after reboot.
